## Summary
Residential burglary in the Fremont neighborhood, 42XX block of Fremont Ave N, reported 2026-11-05 [CC-26-001996:reported_at_iso]. The case is open [CC-26-001996:status]. The offense window runs from 2026-10-28T10:00Z to 2026-10-31T04:00Z, about 66 hours [CC-26-001996:facts.window_hours]. Entry was by prying the rear door [CC-26-001996:mo.entry_method], with pry marks on the frame as the signature [CC-26-001996:mo.signatures]. No witness, suspect description, vehicle description or physical evidence is recorded [CC-26-001996:facts.witness]. Video from a nearby camera is available [CC-26-001996:facts.video_available].

## Property and leads
Stolen items are an Aldane K15 Pro laptop, serial VLX-FUW9X [CC-26-001996:items[CC-26-001996-I1].serial], and a wristwatch with no serial, valued at $4345 [CC-26-001996:items[CC-26-001996-I2].value_usd]. The laptop is valued at $1285 [CC-26-001996:items[CC-26-001996-I1].value_usd].
Lead: pawn record PW-26-001493 at Harborview Gold and Loan has an identical normalised serial to the laptop, received 2026-11-03 [PW-26-001493:received_at]. This is a lead only, and ownership is not verified [PW-26-001493:serial]. The seller is an opaque reference and is not presumed to be the offender [PW-26-001493:seller_ref].
Rejected: PW-26-001489 [PW-26-001489:serial], PW-26-001495 [PW-26-001495:serial] and PW-26-001483 [PW-26-001483:serial] carry conflicting serials and are not matches.

## Linked cases
No series was verified for this case, so no links are claimed [CC-26-001996:mo].

## Open questions
Whether the PW-26-001493 serial matches the victim's purchase records or proof of ownership is not yet confirmed [PW-26-001493:serial]. The wristwatch has no serial or markings, so it is hard to trace [CC-26-001996:items[CC-26-001996-I2].markings]. The time of day of the offense is unknown [CC-26-001996:mo.time_band].

## Suggested next steps
For a human to approve: 
1. Have a detective review the PW-26-001493 record and ask the victim for proof of ownership for the laptop [CC-26-001996:items[CC-26-001996-I1].serial].
2. Collect the nearby camera video for the window [CC-26-001996:facts.video_available].
3. Run series verification on similar rear-door pry cases before claiming any link [CC-26-001996:mo.signatures].
